grammar.label: unreal comparison — as if / as though + past
grammar.form: as if / as though + past simple or past perfect
grammar.meaning: a comparison with something that is not true

explanation.en: When the comparison is imaginary, the verb steps back a tense: 'He talks as if he owned the place' (he does not own it). Past perfect pushes it further back: 'She looked as though she had been crying.' With a real possibility, the present is used: 'It looks as if it is going to rain.'
explanation.uz: Taqqoslash xayoliy bo'lsa, fe'l bir zamon orqaga suriladi: 'He talks as if he owned the place' (aslida u egasi emas). Haqiqiy ehtimol bo'lsa, hozirgi zamon ishlatiladi.

grammar.positive_example: He gives orders as if he owned the company.
grammar.negative_example: He gives orders as if he owns the company, but he is only a clerk.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbekcha 'go'yo' bog'lovchisi zamonni o'zgartirmaydi, shuning uchun orqaga surish unutiladi.

grammar.label: wish and if only + would — complaint about behaviour
grammar.form: I wish / if only + subject + would + base verb
grammar.meaning: irritation at somebody's repeated behaviour, or a wish for change

explanation.en: 'I wish he would listen' complains about what somebody keeps doing. It cannot be used about yourself — 'I wish I would…' is not English — and with states it gives way to the past: 'I wish I were taller', not 'I wish I would be taller'.
explanation.uz: 'I wish he would listen' — birovning takroriy xatti-harakatidan norozilik. O'z-o'ziga nisbatan qo'llanmaydi va holat bildiruvchi fe'llar bilan o'tgan zamon ishlatiladi.

grammar.positive_example: I wish the neighbours would turn the music down.
grammar.negative_example: I wish I would be taller.

l1_notes.uz: 'would' bu yerda kelasi zamon emas, balki o'zgarishga bo'lgan istakni bildiradi.

body.text: After last week. He talks as if he owned the club.

body.text: Because I am the newest coach there. It would look as though I were after his job.

body.text: It might. But he is reportedly leaving in June anyway.

body.speaker: Bobur
body.text: Reportedly. I have heard that twice a year since I arrived.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Then say nothing about him and everything about the training.

body.speaker: Bobur
body.text: I wish the committee would ask me directly. I would answer.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Then be somebody it is easy to ask.
